title: iTRAQ gave way to TMTpro, and the mean isobaric experiment grew from 6 to 13 channels
sub:
PRIDE datasets with isobaric labelling in metadata, 2013–2025 (n = 6,116). a, plex stated in text, among the 4,269 that state one
(highest TMT plex stated is used); iTRAQ 61% → 4% and TMTpro 0% → 48% from 2013–16 to 2023–25. b, mean channels per dataset:
plex stated in text vs reporter channels counted in table headers (independent; channels used ≤ kit size; years with ≥20 datasets).
c, isobaric datasets among all datasets. Shading: 95% CI, group bootstrap over contributor groups.
